resources.string: PIN sign-in, staff and who handled each bill
Everyone uses the app without signing in.
Each person signs in with their own PIN. Staff can only take orders and work with bills; the Admin can do everything.
This is the owner\'s account (the Admin). Choose a name and a PIN of 4 to 6 digits. A recovery code follows, for the day the PIN is forgotten.
Couldn\'t set up staff accounts. Try again.
Enter a name of up to 30 characters.
Another user already has this name.
The PIN must be 4 to 6 digits.
There must be at least one active Admin.
A deactivated user can\'t sign in. Their old sales keep their name.
This user is deactivated and can\'t sign in.
Turning staff accounts off needs an Admin PIN.
A new recovery code needs an Admin PIN. The old code stops working.
Too many wrong tries. Try again in %1$d seconds.
If the Admin PIN is forgotten, this code is the way back in. Write it down or send it to yourself, and keep it away from the café device. It is shown only once.
Cafe Cashier recovery code: %1$s\nKeep it private. It lets you set a new Admin PIN.
